claims.statement: For the homogeneous three-state CTMC S->R at rate a, S->U at c, R->U at b, with a,b,c>0 and an endpoint-at-stop objective, p_R(T)=a(e^{-bT}-e^{-(a+c)T})/(a+c-b) when a+c!=b, and a unique maximizer T*=log((a+c)/b)/(a+c-b), with limit 1/b when a+c=b.
assumptions: fixed context and dose during induction
R endpoint means state R at stop
claims.status: internally_reconstructed_conditional_model_lemma; standard CTMC calculation; biological validity UNKNOWN
claims.novelty_boundary: No novelty claim for standard CTMC/competing-risk optimization; novelty is unassessed.
claims.costs: Estimate transition rates with lineage-resolved cell-time, protein exposure, and independent animal/donor units; computation O(D) over D fixed doses after rate estimation.
claims.falsifier: Held-out fixed-dose trajectories do not show predicted unimodality or probability calibration fails under the fitted rate uncertainty.
claims.next_gate: Obtain a context-specific longitudinal lineage dataset and test the Markov/homogeneous-rate assumptions.

claims.statement: For any gamma>0, scaling a,b,c by gamma preserves the embedded transition-chain probabilities while scaling p_R^gamma(T)=p_R(gamma T) and the optimal fixed-dose pulse duration by 1/gamma; therefore the transition graph alone does not fix quantitative pulse duration.
assumptions: all three rates scaled by the same positive factor
claims.status: internally_proved_exact_obstruction; elementary time rescaling; no biological extrapolation
claims.novelty_boundary: Standard time-rescaling argument; used only to delimit topology-only claims.
claims.costs: Kinetic rates and actual factor exposure must be measured for each relevant tissue/protocol; graph construction alone is insufficient.
claims.falsifier: No biological falsifier for the algebraic identity; the empirical common-rate-scaling hypothesis is falsified if transition-rate ratios change across the compared protocols.
claims.next_gate: Calibrate OSK/OSKM protein exposure and rates under a fixed tissue/injury context.

claims.statement: Primary partial-reprogramming and cardiomyocyte studies report schedule- and context-dependent outcomes; nominal doxycycline-day schedules are not a universal duration interface.
assumptions: claims restricted to the cited mouse/cell systems and their protocols
claims.novelty_boundary: Findings are source-reported experimental results; no cross-study mechanistic reconciliation is asserted.
claims.costs: Protocol, tissue, route, cassette, injury, protein expression, imaging, and animal/donor replication must be accounted for in a prospective comparison.
claims.falsifier: The claim is scoped to published protocols; any broader collapse by measured exposure requires direct within-context data.
claims.next_gate: Compare matched contexts while measuring factor protein trajectories rather than nominal inducer days.

claims.statement: Astra N33/N34/N35 provide scoped reaction-network deterministic containment, exact certificate-status, and finite-horizon stochastic-safety results under supplied assumptions, but do not establish cell-state reachability or a biological safe pulse.
assumptions: pinned knowledge commit and card/proof summaries are accurately read
claims.status: source_derived_unreviewed_prior_record; selective retrieval only; not used as a theorem premise
claims.novelty_boundary: No biological transfer, theorem certification, or priority inference from repository retrieval.
claims.costs: Underlying reaction-certificate acquisition, rates, finite-volume model, controls, and input costs remain source-specific; cell assays are additional costs.
claims.falsifier: Not applicable as a biological assertion; the boundary is the documented model interface.
claims.next_gate: Keep these source cards as analogy only; acquire biological transition data independently.
